# Zyte API coverage

<!-- Generated by `bun scripts/coverage.ts` from scripts/coverage.ts. Do not edit. -->

How much of the [Zyte API](https://docs.zyte.com/zyte-api/usage/reference.html) xyte implements,
field by field, from the OpenAPI spec in `spec/zyte-openapi.json`. A test fails when the spec has
an entry not listed here.

✅ supported · 🟡 partial · 🔌 pluggable (bring an extractor) · ⚪ accepted, no effect · ❌ not supported (request fields: rejected with a 400)

| Area | Supported or partial |
| --- | --- |
| Request fields | 27/56 (+25 pluggable) |
| Response fields | 13/25 (+12 pluggable) |
| Browser actions | 17/20 |

## Request fields

| Name | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | ✅ supported | IP-address hosts are accepted too (Zyte rejects them). |
| `requestHeaders` | ✅ supported | `referer`, on HTTP and browser requests. |
| `tags` | ⚪ accepted | Ignored: there is no Stats API. |
| `ipType` | 🟡 partial | Reaches the provider as `ctx.ipType`; `byIpType()` routes on it. Presets ignore it. |
| `httpRequestMethod` | ✅ supported |  |
| `httpRequestBody` | ✅ supported |  |
| `httpRequestText` | ✅ supported |  |
| `customHttpRequestHeaders` | ✅ supported | `Cookie` is rejected, as on Zyte. |
| `httpResponseBody` | ✅ supported | Truncated at 10 MB. |
| `httpResponseHeaders` | ✅ supported | HTTP and browser (main document) requests. |
| `browserHtml` | ✅ supported | Playwright Chromium, or your own `browser.launch`. |
| `screenshot` | ✅ supported |  |
| `screenshotOptions` | ✅ supported | `format`, `fullPage`. |
| `extractFrom` | 🔌 pluggable | Picks HTTP vs browser for extractors; `userHtml` is not supported. |

| `articleOptions` | 🔌 pluggable | Passed to your extractor as `options`; `extractFrom` picks HTTP or browser. |

## Errors

| Name | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `400 /request/invalid` | ✅ supported | Same field-combination rules, plus unsupported fields. |
| `400 /request/invalid-json` | ✅ supported | Server only. |
| `401 /auth/key-not-found` | ✅ supported | Server with `XYTE_API_KEYS`. |
| `403 /auth/account-suspended` | ⚪ accepted | No accounts. |
| `421 /website/domain-unreachable` | ✅ supported |  |
| `422 /request/unprocessable` | ⚪ accepted | Never emitted. |
| `429 /limits/*` | ⚪ accepted | No quotas; `concurrency` queues instead. |
| `451 /download/domain-forbidden` | ⚪ accepted | Never emitted. |
| `500 /server/timed-out` | 🟡 partial | Attempt timeouts are retried, then reported as 520. |
| `503 /limits/over-global-limit` | ⚪ accepted | Never emitted. |
| `520 /download/temporary-error` | ✅ supported | Bans, proxy failures and network errors after retries. |
| `521 /download/internal-error` | ⚪ accepted | Never emitted. |
